services.name: Salmon Shore Fishing
services.desc: Come fishing with Chum Fun Salmon Charters, Juneau's only shoreside fishing adventure! Duration 3.5 Hours About Here in Juneau, we do a lot of our fishing from the docks and the shoreline. That's why we offer a local, hands-on fishing experience where our guests get to cast and reel instead of sitting in a boat without touching their rods! The Experience Let us get you outfitted with the best gear including rods, reels, tackle, rain gear (rain tops, rain bottoms, and rainboots). Begin with a trip to the Macauley Salmon Hatchery where our guests will learn about the life cycles of an Alaskan salmon, see the saltwater aquarium and explore the saltwater touch tanks.
